summary: Tested the new Regime-Autopilot 'Timeframe-Kette' feature end-to-end. 4/4 backend tests pass (tf-chain preview endpoint for 1h and 15m; autopilot regression without tf_chain; autopilot WITH tf_chain producing correct result keys/order). UI tests pass: admin login works, Regime-Lab opens from tools menu, autopilot-section visible, autopilot-tf-chain checkbox default UNCHECKED and NOT persisted across reload, enabling it reveals autopilot-tf-chain-preview that correctly shows '(15m · 30m · 1h)' for 15m and updates to '(1h · 30m · 2h · 4h)' when top-level TF is switched to 1h. Autopilot history already contains two chain runs rendered with 'autopilot-run-tfchain-<id>' testid showing '⛓ statt 1h' marker when best TF differed. No bugs found in the new feature.
critical_code_review_comments: regime_tf_chain.py is pure/isolated and clean - good separation.
AUTOPILOT_PARAM_KEYS in regime_lab.py correctly includes tf_chain and auto_chain so settings.tf_chain is persisted.
TfChainToggle uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL correctly; preview endpoint is called with URL-encoded timeframe.
Checkbox state is component-local React state only (no localStorage) matching the 'not persisted' requirement.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (verified checkbox default-off, non-persisted, preview correctness for 15m and 1h, history ⛓-marker)

seed_data_creation: Two prior autopilot runs with tf_chain were already present in local DB from main agent testing; left them in place (verified they appear in Autopilot-Verlauf with autopilot-run-tfchain-<id> testid and '⛓ statt 1h' label).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_tf_chain_feature.py. The autopilot run itself takes ~15-25s for 2 rounds on BTCUSDT 120d cloud; the tf_chain=true variant takes ~20-30s because the chain reuses already-loaded candles. Full UI start-to-done E2E test of a chain run from the browser was skipped (long-running + flaky over slow proxy); backend covers the result-shape assertions. UI preview, default-off, non-persistence, chain history '⛓ statt' marker, and tf-switch chain update are all explicitly covered via Playwright. Only data-testid gotcha: admin login modal uses 'admin-username'/'admin-password' (NOT 'admin-login-username').
